Real artifacts for tests/test_units_and_variable_names.py (item 12: units and canonical variable name).

- `085532_variable_pool.json`: the 12 ready Variable records of real run `20260919T085532_98015a8a`
  (Daren-1997-Canopy), including the OCR-garbled `Tüler weight`.
- `085532_column_variables.json`: the 22 distinct column variable labels Step B produced for that run's tables,
  with the units hints it gave (`kg DM`, `Mg m⁻²`, ...).
- `Daren-1997-Canopy/`: the real Table 2 block `b:0119` with its caption and neighbours, unmodified. Its own
  rendering of the units is "kg DI | M m -2" (Marker split "kg DM m-2"); a hint of "kg DM" is therefore NOT
  supported by the source text.
